title: How we met
paragraphs: We met at a friend's wedding celebration, where we were each there to celebrate friends we cared about. Neither of us was looking for a relationship, but sometimes life has other plans. We hit it off almost immediately and spent the evening talking, playing games, and getting to know each other. Before the night was over, Tyler asked Sara out, and a new chapter began.

title: The connection
paragraphs: Our first date involved mini golf, a walk along the river, and sharing plates at The Cheesecake Factory. We were curious about each other, and with every conversation, we found another reason to want to know more.

By our fourth date, something had shifted. Tyler planned one of his Chicago tours for Sara, showing her some of his favorite places around the city, including the Chicago Athletic Association. We ended the evening at Michael Jordan's Steak House, laughing and smiling throughout dinner. When Tyler dropped Sara off at the train, we both knew this was something special. Little did we know that the Chicago Athletic Association would one day be where we'd say “I do.”

title: Our life together
paragraphs: Since then, we've built a life around curiosity, shared values, and a sense of adventure. We both love discovering new places, trying new restaurants, and sharing the things that excite us. Tyler is always ready to embrace an adventure and see where it takes us, while Sara brings a thoughtful perspective and notices the little things along the way. We balance each other in the best ways, encouraging one another to try new things, see different perspectives, and keep growing together. Whether we're exploring somewhere new, tending to the garden, or enjoying our favorite traditions, we're happiest experiencing life together.

title: Love
paragraphs: We said “I love you” for the first time at Starved Rock.

title: Greater together than alone
paragraphs: Now, we're excited to keep growing together, build a family, and share many more adventures. To us, marriage is about more than the two of us. The people in our lives have helped shape who we are, and those experiences and relationships helped make us the people who found each other. We wouldn't be who we are, or the couple we are today, without our family and friends.

title: The proposal
paragraphs: Our engagement was a love letter to the story we'd been building. Over the course of a summer, Tyler took Sara back to places that held special memories for us. When the day finally came, he surprised her with an indoor picnic surrounded by photos and mementos from our time together, celebrating the journey that brought us here and all the adventures still to come.

title: What marriage means to us
paragraphs: That's why having you celebrate with us means so much. We're bringing together the people who have been part of our stories, and we can't think of a better way to begin this next chapter than surrounded by all of you.
